verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has a dedicated versioning page stating that a new endpoint version ships whenever a backwards-incompatible change is released. The reference docs show versioned endpoints in use (v2 audit trail, v2 customer lookup, v3 transaction process). The pack contains no deprecation policy covering notice periods, sunset timelines or how old versions are retired, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, deprecation signalling (e.g. headers or changelog), and independent corroboration.
